criteriaLedger.viewport: 1920x1080 CSS pixels at 100%; page vertical scroll, matrix horizontal scroll only
criteriaLedger.calendar: PeriodDay is authoritative; Asia/Seoul today main cycle plus next five, exactly six unique contiguous Thursday rows; no ISO week or 52-week fallback
criteriaLedger.request: country plus explicit year and majorWeek; year/majorWeek omitted together means current cycle; partial or outside-six scope rejected
criteriaLedger.sqlScope: v.OrderYear=@orderYear AND v.OrderWeek LIKE @majorWeek + '-%' and exact server country mapping
criteriaLedger.subweeks: derive actual full OrderWeek values only; numeric subweek then exact suffix ordering; never invent 01 or 02
criteriaLedger.customerCode: Customer.OrderCode by CustKey, never ViewOrder.OrderCode, CustCode or internal key fallback; missing code retained
criteriaLedger.customerIdentity: ERP uses CustKey; duplicate OrderCode remains separate and gets display-only CustKey suffix
criteriaLedger.uploadCustomerColumns: preserve legacy Netherlands precedence: explicit <code> Total is the sole source when present; do not add same-code detail columns again; without Total, same-code detail columns are summed; prefix recognition must not change this
criteriaLedger.productIdentity: ERP uses ProdKey; uploaded duplicate product-name rows are summed per customer code with row-number warning instead of last-row overwrite
criteriaLedger.netherlandsErpQuantity: stored ViewOrder.SteamQuantity only for every OutUnit; never infer from OutQuantity, BunchQuantity, SteamOf1Bunch or product name
criteriaLedger.productUnitDisplay: Current Product.OutUnit, SteamOf1Bunch, BunchOf1Box and SteamOf1Box are display-only metadata, not historical quantity conversion authority. Show current basis separately from saved order quantities and export unit; zero or missing factors are not replaced with one.
criteriaLedger.zeroQuantityDisplay: Hide numeric zero quantity cells in matrix and preview; Excel quantity cells use [=0] empty display with General for nonzero values while keeping stored values and formulas. Diagnostic zero values, product identities and rows remain visible.
criteriaLedger.netherlandsUploadQuantity: uploaded numeric value is already stems and is preserved exactly; no tulip, hyacinth, skimmia, eucalyptus or other name multiplier
criteriaLedger.missingNetherlandsStems: positive order evidence with SteamQuantity<=0 is retained and blocks export as STEM_QUANTITY_UNAVAILABLE
criteriaLedger.codeRecognition: trimmed case-insensitive ^[A-Z]*CL[A-Z0-9_-]*$ recognizes CL, BCL, HCL, KCL, MCL, YCL and suffix variants; unknown non-empty codes retained with warning
criteriaLedger.staleRequests: AbortController plus request generation and exact response scopeKey; stale/cancelled/partial responses cannot mutate current state or enable download
criteriaLedger.converterBoundary: CountryOrderMatrix and generatePedidosFromMatrix are ERP-only additions; do not rewrite generatePedidos(workbook, ...) or unrelated country upload parsers
criteriaLedger.sideEffects: authenticated GET SELECT plus browser-local parse/export only; no ERP or web-table write
criteriaLedger.exportProductOrder: Each generated workbook sorts product names A-Z case-insensitively before writing rows/formulas, for ERP and uploaded input. Country/category/unit file splits remain unchanged. Ecuador retains adjacent half-box pairing after name sorting.

rows.name: original ProdName
rows.flower: original FlowerName; exact Colombia category when applicable

rows.storedQuantities: saved outQuantity/boxQuantity/bunchQuantity/steamQuantity totals; null preserves missing evidence
rows.storedQuantitiesByCustomer: same saved quantity fields keyed by CustKey; diagnostics only

Colombia.erp: OutQuantity with existing category requirements validated

crossYearFixture.description: 2025/42-01 and 2026/42-01 coexist but an explicit 2026/42 request returns only 2026; a current 2026/52 calendar continues through actual 2027 rows without OrderWeek-only matching

positiveFixtures: Asia/Seoul 2026-10-15 resolves to ERP 2026/42 and buttons 42 through 47
Netherlands OutUnit bunch with stored BunchQuantity 20 and SteamQuantity 200 exports 200 stems
Netherlands OutUnit stem with stored SteamQuantity 150 exports 150 stems
uploaded Netherlands total 9220 is unchanged even when product names contain tulip, hyacinth, skimmia or eucalyptus
BCL16 KCL03 HCL07 MCL73 YCLS are recognized and preserved
uploaded explicit KCL03 Total takes precedence over KCL03 detail columns
uploaded same-code detail columns are summed when no explicit Total exists
Unsorted mixed-case product names export A-Z in all country workbooks with quantities and formulas attached to the original product
nearMissFixtures: same OrderWeek in prior year is excluded
positive Netherlands bunch quantity with SteamQuantity zero remains visible and blocks export
duplicate Customer.OrderCode with different CustKey does not merge
duplicate ERP ProdName with different ProdKey does not overwrite
duplicate uploaded product-name rows sum per customer code and emit a row-number warning instead of overwriting
explicit uploaded code Total plus same-code detail columns is not double-counted
missing Customer.OrderCode remains as an explicit column
late response for a previous country or cycle cannot replace the current matrix
ambiguous uploaded product column fails instead of guessing
2025 and 2026 same-week matrices sort independently without changing sourceScope or source input
